podcast.body: This was a great guitar-driven album that had the misfortune of being released at the wrong place and time in the UK. After Radiohead's "OK Computer," the guitar sound was gradually dying in the mid-90s, especially in the UK. This album was compared to "OK Computer" due to surprising similarities in Matt Bellamy's singing style (at the time) and the "weeping, agonizing, tragic" guitar sound. Some guitar publications even noted similar pedal structures used by both bands. It was a welcome album for rock fans in 1999 when there were few releases of that style, but critics were looking elsewhere. "Este fue un grandísimo álbum guitarrero que tuvo la mala suerte de que tanto míos como el showbiz estaban en el momento equivocado en el lugar equivocado."
